guide.summary: Basilica, palaces, civic museums, the 2026 Art Biennale and island trattorias, with cafés, dinners and a cocktail bar checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Check closing days before you plan the day: the Peggy Guggenheim Collection is closed on Tuesdays, and the Biennale Arte is closed on Mondays except 16 November.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Peggy Guggenheim Collection closes on Tuesdays, Fondazione Querini Stampalia and the Biennale Arte on Mondays (the Biennale opens Monday 16 November). Antiche Carampane closes Sundays and Mondays, Al Covo Tuesdays and Wednesdays, and Da Romano on Burano on Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.value: Book ahead for tours and the Biennale
toolkit.copy: Torre dell'Orologio is visited only on booked guided tours that meet at the Museo Correr ticket office, and late arrivals of over 15 minutes are excluded. Biennale tickets are sold online and need a reservation.

toolkit.label: Timing and late openings
toolkit.copy: Palazzo Ducale is open 09:00-19:00 to 31 October, then 09:00-18:00 from 1 November, with last entry an hour before closing. Ca' Pesaro and Museo Fortuny stay open until 20:00 from 20 to 22 November 2026.

toolkit.label: Bags and age rules
toolkit.copy: Palazzo Ducale bars suitcases and trolleys, and large bags, backpacks and umbrellas go in its free storage. Children under 6 are not allowed on Torre dell'Orologio tours but enter the Biennale free.

guide.dek: Book the Torre dell'Orologio tour and Biennale entry ahead, and plan restaurant dinners around their midweek closing days.
intro: Your Venice visit can start in Piazza San Marco, where the Basilica di San Marco sells online tickets for the Basilica, the Pala d'Oro, the Museo and Loggia dei Cavalli, the Campanile and evening visits. Next door, Palazzo Ducale is open 09:00-19:00 until 31 October and 09:00-18:00 from 1 November, with last entry an hour before closing. Its 'Ospiti a Palazzo' display runs to 23 March 2027. The Museo Correr shows Bizhan Bassiri and 'Spiral Economy. Charrière and Canova' until 22 November 2026.

Across the Grand Canal in Dorsoduro, the Gallerie dell'Accademia has Leiko Ikemura's 'TransLucent' until 22 November. Its 2026 news also reports that the Miracoli della Vera Croce are back on view. The Peggy Guggenheim Collection is open daily 10 am-6 pm except Tuesdays, and 'Fucina degli Angeli', on twentieth-century artistic glass, opens on 14 November 2026. Ca' Rezzonico shows 'Nel segno di Venezia' until 11 January 2027. The Biennale Arte 2026, 'In Minor Keys', closes on 22 November and is open 10 am-6 pm in its final weeks.

In Santa Croce, Ca' Pesaro shows Jenny Saville until 22 November 2026, and Palazzo Mocenigo has 'Un merletto per Venezia 2026' until 6 January 2027. The Museo di Storia Naturale is an easy family stop, with 'Dietro le quinte 2026' until 15 November. In San Marco, Museo Fortuny shows Erwin Wurm's 'Dreamers', and both Fortuny and Ca' Pesaro open until 20:00 from 20 to 22 November. Scuola Grande di San Rocco is open daily 9:30-17:30, and at La Fenice the opera season opens with 'Fedora' from 13 November.

For coffee, Gran Caffè Quadri on the Piazza opens daily from 9:30 to midnight, and Caffè Florian's menu covers breakfast and afternoon tea. Book dinner ahead. Antiche Carampane charges €35 per cover for late cancellations and closes Sundays and Mondays, and Al Covo serves dinner 19:30-22:00 from Thursday to Monday. On the islands, Venissa on Mazzorbo takes online bookings, and Da Romano on Burano serves lunch every day except Tuesday.
summaryCards: Pair the Basilica di San Marco and Palazzo Ducale with a booked Torre dell'Orologio tour that starts from the Museo Correr ticket office.
Have a coffee at Gran Caffè Quadri from 9:30, then visit Fondazione Querini Stampalia, open Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 with its Cafè Mariona.
Biennale tickets need an online reservation, and Antiche Carampane charges €35 per cover for cancellations after noon on the day.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several civic museum homepages showed only that day's hours, not a weekly schedule. Basilica di San Marco hours sit on an external ticketing site that was not read. Caffè Florian, Al Covo, Trattoria alla Madonna and Experimental Cocktail Club Venice had no 2026-dated item and are rated medium confidence. Fondazione Querini Stampalia says its new website is still under construction. No dedicated bakery could be confirmed, so the bakery list uses Caffè Florian's pastry menu. These sites could not be read: Palazzo Grassi, Fondazione Cini, Torrefazione Cannaregio, Caffè Lavena and Ristorante Local (403 or fetch error), Ristorante Quadri and Majer (429), the Basilica dei Frari visit pages (404 or login screen), Il Mercante (expired certificate) and the City of Venice Rialto Market page (empty).
